description: Logical calls of vector network analyzers (VNA). PROVISIONAL: written from the manuals of the Zenko LiteVNA, the Siglent SNA/SHN series and the Rohde & Schwarz ZNB/ZNL (mandatory = documented in every manual of the category). Complex results are returned as arrays of real and imaginary parts. Calibration is a flow: calibration_begin, calibration_measure (once per standard), calibration_apply.

calibration_standard.description: calibration standard connected to the test port(s). OPEN, SHORT, LOAD (a matched 50 ohm termination, 'match' on some instruments) and THRU (a known through between two ports) are the classic ones. REFLECT: a reflection of unknown but equal value at both ports (TRL, TRM). LINE: the line of a TRL calibration. TRL_THRU: the through of a TRL calibration (separate from THRU because some instruments measure it with its own command). UNKNOWN_THRU: a through whose length is not known (the second through of the unknown-thru calibration). ISOLATION: the isolation between two ports measured with terminated ports (optional extra of the response, enhanced-response and two-port calibrations). ATTENUATION and NETWORK: the standards of the TNA calibration

calibration_kind.description: ONE_PORT: full one-port calibration (OPEN, SHORT, LOAD on the port; three error terms); REFLECTION_OPEN / REFLECTION_SHORT: reflection normalisation with one standard (tracking only); TRANSMISSION_RESPONSE: normalisation of the transmission from port (the source) to port2 with a THRU (an instrument that only offers the version for both directions does it in both); TRANSMISSION_RESPONSE_BOTH: the same in both directions; ENHANCED_RESPONSE: OPEN, SHORT, LOAD on the source port plus a THRU, for transmission in one direction (also called one path two ports; corrects source match as well); TWO_PORT: full two-port calibration with a known THRU (SOLT, TOSM, twelve-term model: OPEN, SHORT, LOAD on both ports and a THRU); TWO_PORT_UNKNOWN_THRU: the same with an unknown through (UOSM, SOLR: OPEN, SHORT, LOAD on both ports and an UNKNOWN_THRU); TOM: OPEN and LOAD on both ports and a THRU; TSM: SHORT and LOAD on both ports and a THRU; TRM: REFLECT and LOAD on both ports and a THRU; TRL: REFLECT on both ports, a TRL_THRU and a LINE (no matched load needed; limited bandwidth); TNA: THRU, ATTENUATION and NETWORK (the least demanding standards). See docs/vna-calibration-types.md

sparameters.description: dict with "frequency" (array, Hz), "parameters" ({name: {"real": array, "imaginary": array}} for each selected S-parameter) and "calibrated" (bool: the calibration of the application or of the instrument was applied)

calibration_data.description: calibration of an instrument whose calibration is computed by the driver (LiteVNA): grid (start Hz, step Hz, points), reflection error terms and transmission reference, as lists of [real, imaginary]

calibration_kit.description: values of a calibration kit with parasitics, for instruments that calibrate in software: open_c0 (fF), open_c1 (1e-27 F/Hz), open_c2 (1e-36), open_c3 (1e-45), short_l0 (pH), short_l1 (1e-24 H/Hz), short_l2 (1e-33), short_l3 (1e-42), open_delay, short_delay, thru_delay (ps), open_loss, short_loss, thru_loss (Gohm/s), open_z0, short_z0, thru_z0 (ohm); a missing value is ideal

sweep_type.description: frequency sweep: points evenly spaced in frequency (LINEAR) or on a logarithmic scale (LOG)

identification_query.description: instrument identification (manufacturer, model, hardware and firmware)

set_frequency_sweep.description: linear frequency sweep from start to stop frequency with a number of points

set_sweep_type.description: linear or logarithmic frequency sweep; call it after set_frequency_sweep, which sets a linear sweep

run_sweep.description: start a sweep and discard the data of the previous one (read_sparameters then returns this sweep)

read_sparameters.description: sweep (when the instrument needs it) and read the frequencies and the complex values of the asked S-parameters

calibration_begin.description: choose the calibration and the ports; the standards are then measured with calibration_measure

port.description: test port (the source port of a transmission calibration)

port2.description: second test port (the receiving port of a transmission calibration, the other port of a two-port calibration)

calibration_measure.description: measure a calibration standard connected to the port(s) given to calibration_begin

calibration_apply.description: compute the calibration from the measured standards and use it for the next read_sparameters

calibration_ecal.description: calibrate with an electronic calibration unit (ECal, automatic calibration unit) connected to the test ports: one call, no standards to connect or measure, no calibration_apply afterwards. Only for the kinds a model lists in its ecal_kinds

port.description: test port (the source port of a transmission calibration)

port2.description: second test port (the receiving port of a transmission calibration, the other port of a two-port calibration)

set_correction_state.description: use (true) or bypass (false) the calibration in read_sparameters

calibration_clear.description: forget the measured standards and the calibration

set_calibration_kit.description: the calibration kit used by the next calibration (OPEN capacitance, SHORT inductance, offset delays and losses, THRU delay); an instrument that has its kit defined in its own settings does not take it

calibration_export.description: the calibration computed by the driver, to save it with the project (only for instruments that do not keep it themselves)

calibration_import.description: restore a calibration exported by calibration_export for the same frequency sweep
